title: Connected components
summary: Start a search from every vertex no search has reached yet. Each new start is a new component.

checkpoints.text: Seven vertices and four separate edges. `component` is all zeros: no vertex belongs to a component yet.
A depth-first search from 0 reached 1 and 2. They all get the number 1 (shown under each vertex).
1 and 2 are skipped: they already have a component. 3 has none, so it starts component 2.
3 connected components: {0, 1, 2}, {3, 4} and {5, 6}. Every vertex and edge was looked at once, so this is O(V + E) with lists, O(V²) with a matrix.
